# Sakura

> Sakura is an open-source, local-first AI character companion and VTuber studio for Windows, Android and macOS. It renders Live2D Cubism, PMX (MMD) and VRM characters, tracks face and body from a webcam or phone, speaks with on-device speech synthesis, and runs on a local LLM by default. An approval-based desktop agent handles computer tasks with explicit consent.

## Canonical

- Website: https://soulofswords.github.io/Sakura-website/
- Source: https://github.com/soulofswords/Sakura
- Unity client: https://github.com/soulofswords/Sakura-Unity
- Downloads: https://github.com/soulofswords/Sakura-Downloads/releases

## Facts

- License: GPL-3.0.
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 x64, Android 9+, macOS.
- Character formats: Live2D Cubism, PMX/PMD, VRM 0.x/1.0.
- AI: local GGUF model served by llama-server by default; Ollama import and an ordered cloud fallback are optional.
- Voice: on-device text-to-speech and voice conversion; optional cloud speech.
- Privacy: models, memory and conversation stay local unless a cloud feature is explicitly configured.
- The desktop agent requires approval before actions; it is not autonomous purchasing or messaging.
